name: Jarvis Pre-Prompt
description: Injects self-model JSON and world-model snapshot into the system prompt, plus the H6 channel-trust instruction block. Memory retrieval is handled by jarvis-memory; this plugin does NOT duplicate memory recall.

selfModelUrl.description: Base URL of the self-model sidecar. Default: http://self-model-svc:3035.

worldModelUrl.description: Base URL of the world-model sidecar. Default: http://world-model-svc:3032.

httpTimeoutMs.description: Per-sidecar timeout (default: 500ms). Hook proceeds with empty injection on timeout.

injectSelfModel.description: Inject self-model JSON into prependSystemContext (cacheable). Default: true.

injectWorldModel.description: Inject world-model snapshot into prependContext (per-turn). Default: true.

injectChannelTrust.description: Inject the H6 channel-trust instruction block into prependSystemContext. Default: true.

channelTrustOverride.description: Optional override for the channel-trust instruction text. If not set, uses the built-in H6 default.
